# Run ledger — P25.1 (LIVE-OPS.1 / live-fetch operationalization)

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P25.1__live-fetch-operationalization.md` (semantic `LIVE-OPS.1`, P25+ backlog)
- **Branch:** `devin/deploy-gcp-live` (post-chain operational branch — **landed interactively,
  not via an `implement-spec` dispatch**; this ledger is the retroactive record, written 2026-09-15)

## What landed

1. **ADR-083 API-vs-crawl carve-out implemented** — `data/api_allowlist.toml` +
   `PoliteFetcher`/transport wiring: documented, rate-limited API access to allow-listed
   host+prefix pairs is API mode; every other host stays robots-governed CRAWL.
   Hosts listed: overpass + lz4 mirror, api.data.gov, catalog.data.gov, api.usaspending.gov
   (POST), www.muckrock.com + accounts.muckrock.com, api.openstreetmap.org /api/0.6,
   www.data.gouv.fr /api/1/, static.data.gouv.fr /resources/.
2. **`data/live_targets.toml` live** — the runner's `_run_live` drives `discover()` from the
   declarative table; a green source with no target raises `NoLiveTargets` (never a placeholder).
3. **Content-drift hardening** — Atlas live-schema fix (`Type`→`Technology` via
   `atlas_vocab.toml` `columns.category_column_candidates`, vocab 2026.09.15) — real schema
   drift found on the live CSV, mapped as a versioned migration; a genuinely missing field
   still raises `ContentDrift`.
4. **First real live fetch** — `osm_overpass` → 4,465 claims into the hosted Cloud SQL spine.

## Acceptance evidence

- `uv run python -m connectors validate` → 25 loadable; `run --mode live` refuses a gated
  source exit 3 before any socket; `tests/connectors/test_live_targets.py` green.
- Live fetch record: `run --source osm_overpass --mode live --sink pg` → 4,465 claims.
